title: Razor-sharp stone cuts at Kef Kalesi

tellings.quote: examples from ke excuse me from KF kesi that have um cuts that are so sharp you can still cut your finger on them

plain: At Kef Kalesi, an ancient site in Turkey, some of the stone cuts are so sharp that you can still cut your finger on them, according to a researcher named Matt LaCroix. LaCroix gives this to Michels as an example, without naming a source, while arguing that something big happened around 12,000 BC. If true, it would point to very skilled stonework in the distant past.
